reviewedAssertions: Selected literal loopback endpoint only; actual process SIGKILL.
Before kill: durable STARTED, actual Write-entry marker, real prefix bytes at receiver; no observed return marker. After kill: drained exact prefix shorter than full payload.
Second boundary: actual Send returned Submitted with complete primary/cut bytes at receiver, before durable primary disposition.
Both: reopened SQLite integrity ok, UNCERTAIN hold, zero automatic recovery calls, exact original acceptance receipt, one job/attempt.
qualificationLimits: DuringWrite observes actual prefix delivery, Write entered and no persisted return marker at kill; it does not locate instruction-exact syscall state because wrapper return/marker gap exists.
AfterWrite observes complete immutable bytes/cut and Submitted before queue settlement; Submitted is not paper delivered.
Only macOS tested here; Windows TerminateProcess/SCM/OS/physical acceptance are distinct.
